scope: A fixed composition of existing operators under the current PLAN. Not a new mechanism, new measured method, or new task queue.
inputs: existing frozen DINOv3-L weights and their configuration

encoder.image_transform: PIL RGB -> Resize((1024,1024), bilinear) -> ToTensor -> ImageNet mean/std
encoder.dtype_contract: FP32 model and input; autocast disabled; TF32 disabled
encoder.historical_dtype_parity: not established; preserve old reported scores as old results

evidence_and_region_prior.definition: stage_bank.foris(mode=source), response(upto=prior); do not use penalty or delta in the resulting field
evidence_and_region_prior.foreground_tokens: stage_bank.down_bilinear, including nearest and centroid fallbacks
evidence_and_region_prior.debias_gate: source semantic cosine < 0.8; nearest reference token mask; empty nearest foreground applies projection
evidence_and_region_prior.background: mean of hardest 20 percent reference background tokens, orthogonalized to reference foreground mean, normalized
evidence_and_region_prior.vote: nearest reference-token label with reference features normalized over HEIGHT, preserving stage_bank behavior
evidence_and_region_prior.candidate: vote OR regular step-2 token grid
evidence_and_region_prior.seed: argmax(region mean query/foreground cosine * candidate fraction); regions with no candidate excluded
evidence_and_region_prior.prior: cross * nonnegative seed/region prototype cosine * candidate fraction; seed boosted to maximum; region minmax broadcast to tokens

graph_features.definition: same encoder pair; source conditional native projection in FP32 via (I-U@U.T)@X then channel normalization; round retained descriptors through FP16, convert to FP32 and normalize per token
graph_features.note: This is a separate numeric branch from the stage_bank score projection, as the old host experiment used rebuilt score fields and native cached graph tokens. Independent reconstruction parity remains unverified.

rcg.reference_coverage: area resize of the supplied 1024 reference mask to 64
rcg.guide: max_F(2*cosine - reference top10 mean)-query top10 mean
rcg.score_scaling: per-image minmax with span denominator floor 1e-6
rcg.graph: reciprocal cosine nearest neighbors; geometric mean of adaptive exponential edge weights; normalize mean weighted degree

fine_readout.space: channel-normalized shifted last-layer features, same native projection decision as coarse graph features, renormalize and retain FP32
fine_readout.coarse_guide: normalize FP32-converted FP16 native query descriptors
fine_readout.fine_interleaving: negative shifts populate even rows/columns; positive shifts odd
fine_readout.parameter_source: fixed global readout from rcg2_frozen.json; inherited source600 selection, no new fitting; deliberately not the old fold-specific 0.07/0.15 selector

parameter_provenance: Existing development-selected RCG constants and source600-selected global fine parameters. No added label fitting; never claim no historical use of labels for selection.
exact_optimization_description: min_{z,f} 0.5*(z-y)^T A*(z-y)+8*z^T L*z subject to f=B*z; mask=f>0.5. A,L,y and B are computed by the fixed preceding operators. This does not optimize the prototypes, seed, ranking, or readout weights jointly.
comparisons_fixed: same S3 + RCG16 + bilinear coarse readout: fine increment
same S3 + historical MEAN_a0.25_l16 + same global fine15: simple reference-guide control
released INSID3 complete with 640 CRF, explicit existing implementation/dtype caveat
complete FoRIS final score + RCG16 coarse: existing strong complete baseline
complete FoRIS final score + MEAN_a0.25_l16 coarse: existing strong complete baseline
complete FoRIS final score + RCG16 + same global fine15: same readout/encoder-budget control
mean_control_definition: Retains the same reciprocal query graph, confidence weighting and lambda16 solve; guide is query cosine to normalized mean of reference pure foreground tokens and alpha=0.25. It is NOT a graph-free spatial averaging control.

cohorts.name: CONFIRM1200
cohorts.exposure: previously registered as photo disjoint; current exposure recheck pending

cohorts.name: LVIS
cohorts.exposure: reused cross-dataset episodes; images may overlap COCO

cross_dataset_binding_limits: The saved row order is fixed. SUIM/PASCAL-Part exported image roots and binary-mask binding still need metadata binding. PACO-Part/LVIS rows have shard-local image paths and remapped stored c values; the key prefix identifies the source shard. Original class mapping and photo IDs must be bound before evaluation; never treat numeric e/fold or exported basenames as unique original photo identities.

evaluation.metric: mean over classes of summed intersection / summed union
evaluation.paired_bootstrap: 2000 RandomState(0) connected support/query photo-group draws; absent classes omitted in each replicate
